title: Sharp Bohr-Type Inequalities Involving Euler Operator and Area Functionals on $\mathbb{P}Δ(0;1_n)$
summary: In this paper, we establish several higher-dimensional generalizations of refined Bohr-type inequalities for bounded holomorphic functions mapping into the unit polydisk $\mathbb{P}Δ(0;1_n)$ in $\mathbb{C}^n$. First, we formulate multidimensional analogues of sharp Bohr-type inequalities originally established by Liu \emph{et al.} [{\it Bull. Sci. Math.} {\bf 173} (2021) 103054], incorporating both squared coefficient terms and area functional components.
